text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, still, Espo-san is...
such a devoted daughter to her mother, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Caring about someone's health
and sending them all kinds of things...
It's truly wonderful~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such consideration for a mother...
I wanted to show Wonder Acute the same kind of care.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'm going to spoil you a lot today!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Filial piety? From Trainer-san
to me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~, hearing that makes me kinda happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we spent the entire day at the Yukoma Onsen doing everything Wonder Acute wanted to do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When you think of hot springs, you think table tennis!
And when you think table tennis, you think hot springs.
I've been waaaanting to play so badly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm not pulling any punches, okay?
Yo, hup!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tohhhh! Wonder Smaaaash!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Played a lot of onsen ping-pong—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's do a pickle taste test.
Including the crunchy ones I made.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let's see, how do the Yukoma pickles taste...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Scratch, scratch, scratch...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, these are wonderfully pickled!
With just a hint of wasabi to give it that kick...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well now, this is mighty tasty, quite a surprise.
Here, here, Trainer, have some yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us happily ate the pickles together,
and in the end...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, footbaths... are the absolute best.
Trainer, let's soak together side-by-side and just relax~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today~. I truly,
truly had a wonderful time~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly a lucky one, ye know.
Being able to meet such a wonderful Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute looks truly satisfied. Just as I'm glad I could treat her well...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Accu-san,
you were with Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tran-san.
Are you here for the footbath too?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And also to check on Accu-san.
To make sure she's not having any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still, with you around, Trainer-chan, I guess it'll be fine. If there's anything only I can help with, just let me know~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Let's see.
If it's something that only Tran-san could help with...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. Let's do this!
You see, I lost to Espo-san in a mock race the other day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "I want to get my revenge someday. But it'd be lonely with just the two of us, right? So..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Would you join in too when the time comes, Tran-san?
Just like before, 1800m on the dirt."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a mock race! Nice, nice! Gets the heart pumpin'!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Accu-san, you're always hanging out with Rickey-chan
and Tarumae-chan, but let's hang out just the three of us sometimes!
It's a promise, then!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, looking forward to working with you, Tran-san.
I'm definitely not gonna lose this time around, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's also to repay my Trainer for being so kind to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having made a promise to race,
Wonder Acute spent a deeply fulfilling day.
